# bitwrap.io

> Petri nets as ZK containers. A single Go binary that turns a Petri net
> schema (`.btw` DSL or JSON-LD) into Solidity contracts, Foundry tests, and
> Groth16 circuits — no hand-written gnark — and runs the flagship
> application: anonymous on-chain voting where every ballot carries a ZK
> proof, results stay sealed until close, and the tally is publicly
> auditable. Models are content-addressed (CID via URDNA2015 JSON-LD
> canonicalization). API is CORS-open; client modules are dependency-free ES
> modules.

The core idea: a Petri net's structure maps directly onto circuit
constraints. Keyed input arcs become Merkle membership proofs, keyed output
arcs become post-state commitments, guards become range checks, roles become
caller-equality checks, and ZKOps (nullifier-bind, commitment-bind) become
hash-derivation constraints. One `.btw` source yields contract + tests +
circuits + witness builders that agree byte-for-byte.

## Docs

- [Full guide](https://bitwrap.io/llms-full.txt): voting protocol, every API
  endpoint, `.btw` DSL, circuit synthesis, client modules, operator CLI
- [README](https://github.com/stackdump/bitwrap-io#readme): quick start,
  architecture, license (MIT)
- [Book](https://book.pflow.xyz): Petri nets as a universal abstraction

## Apps

- [Polls](https://bitwrap.io/poll): create a poll (wallet-signed), register,
  cast a Groth16-proven vote, read sealed/closed results
- [Editor](https://bitwrap.io/editor): visual Petri net editor; save models
  as content-addressed JSON-LD, load ERC-20/721/1155/Vote templates
- [Remix plugin](https://bitwrap.io/remix): generate and deploy contracts
  inside Remix IDE (also at solver.bitwrap.io)

## API

- [Polls](https://bitwrap.io/api/polls): `POST` create / `GET` list; per-poll
  `/vote`, `/register`, `/registry`, `/close`, `/reveal`, `/results`,
  `/nullifiers`, `/votes`, `/aggregate` (v3 close), `/tally`, `/tally-proof`
- [Templates](https://bitwrap.io/api/templates): list ERC templates;
  `/api/templates/{id}` returns the full JSON-LD model
- [Circuits](https://bitwrap.io/api/circuits): list compiled Groth16
  circuits; `POST /api/prove` with a witness; `GET /api/vk/{circuit}` and
  `/api/vk/{circuit}/solidity` for verifying key + Solidity verifier
- [Codegen](https://bitwrap.io/api/bundle/vote): `POST /api/solgen`,
  `/api/testgen`, `/api/genesisgen`, `/api/compile` (.btw → schema JSON);
  `GET /api/bundle/{vote|vote-v3}` downloads a complete Foundry project ZIP
- [Models](https://bitwrap.io/api/save): `POST /api/save` returns `{cid}`;
  `GET /o/{cid}` loads JSON-LD; `GET /img/{cid}.svg` and `POST /api/svg`
  render SVG

## Client modules (ES modules, zero deps)

- [mimc.js](https://bitwrap.io/mimc.js): MiMC-BN254 hash (pure BigInt)
- [merkle.js](https://bitwrap.io/merkle.js): fixed-depth binary Merkle tree
  with proof generation
- [witness-builder.js](https://bitwrap.io/witness-builder.js): witness
  builders for every generated circuit
- [pedersen.js](https://bitwrap.io/pedersen.js): BabyJubJub Pedersen
  commitments (v3 homomorphic tally)
- [prover.js](https://bitwrap.io/prover.js): browser-side Groth16 proving
  via prover.wasm in a Web Worker
- [seal-cid.mjs](https://bitwrap.io/seal-cid.mjs): CID computation matching
  the Go sealer
- [petri-view.js](https://bitwrap.io/petri-view.js): `<petri-view>` editor
  web component (vendored from pflow.xyz; fix bugs upstream)

## Related

- [pflow.xyz](https://pflow.xyz): canonical Petri net editor + ODE/simulation
  library; source of the shared browser modules
- [beats.bitwrap.io](https://beats.bitwrap.io): Petri-net beat sequencer
